note: Recorded from the MusicBrainz WS2 JSON API on 2026-10-30 and trimmed to the fields src/main/album-personnel.ts reads. Three requests in order: the release-group search, the browse of the accepted group's releases (inc=labels, so the label rides along), and the lookup of the release pickRelease() chooses with inc=artist-rels+recordings+recording-level-rels. Relations are kept only where the target is an artist (the module reads nothing else).
